title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Blue Razz GB Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz GB delivers a blue raspberry taste with a confectionery-style gummy bear twist. The profile combines bright berry notes with soft candy sweetness for a clear, fruit-led vape. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can enjoy long-range performance without manual refills or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide defined flavour, smooth MTL vapour and quick nicotine satisfaction. Discover all our flavours: Explore full flavours of Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Refill Pods How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
